Sophie — thanks for the note and the intake form. Welcome! Below are the items procurement requires and the expected sequence so we can get Nimbus live quickly: 

1) DPA: I am attaching our current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.docx). Please sign via DocuSign and return — procurement won't create a PO until the DPA is fully executed. If you prefer to countersign a vendor-supplied DPA, we can review, but that will add time.

2) SOC 2: here's a secure link to download the latest report (read-only access): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2-report-2026.pdf. If you need a restricted-viewer copy, tell me and I'll raise a request with Security.

3) Subprocessors: we maintain an up-to-date subprocessor inventory. I can export the CSV — attaching the template you should expect to receive back: subprocessor_inventory_template.csv (we'll populate details after you confirm the DPA).

4) PO & invoicing: once DPA is executed and vendor intake info is in our finance system, Procurement issues a PO. Typical turnaround after signed DPA is 1-2 business days for a standard vendor record and PO creation. Payment terms for Nimbus will default to Net 30 unless vendor setup indicates otherwise. Our AP team will request a W-9 (US) or tax equivalent during vendor creation.

Action items for Nimbus:
- Complete DocuSign for the attached DPA (I will send the DocuSign envelope to the email on file).
- Confirm billing address and remittance details on the intake form.
- Send any exceptions to our DPA (redlines) within 48 hours so we can route to Legal.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.docx, po_instructions.pdf

I'll start the vendor record ticket as soon as Sophie confirms DocuSign intent. Ben / Laura — can you flag this for expedited PO creation once the signed DPA arrives?

Thanks,
